title: Simultaneous DNA and RNA Extraction from Oyster Tissues for Metabarcoding
author: Martina Strittmatter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.22aggae
materials: DNA and RNA concentration and purity are measured on 2 µl aliquots using a nanodrop spectrophotometer. The integrity of the RNAs can furthermore be assessed via Bioanalyzer of LabChip. Note that oyster RNA does not show a 28S RNA peak in the electropherogram. This is most likely due to a thermoconversion of the 28S rRNA during sample preparation (heating) for Bioanalyzer/LabChip analysis and has also been described for insect RNA (doi: 10.1673/031.010.14119 ) and snail RNA ( DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0148390 ). Typical electropherograms (red and blue) and virtual gel image of two O. edulis gill RNA samples.

steps.title: Prepare Oyster Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare oyster tissues for nucleic acid extraction under sterile conditions in a laminar flow hood.

substeps.instruction: Wipe tools (pipettes, forceps) with RNase away.
Transfer oyster tissues (digestive gland (DG), gills (G)) into microcollection tubes containing one 5 mm stainless steel bead.
Close tubes with strip caps, piercing each cap with a fine needle to avoid pressure build-up.
Keep tissues frozen in liquid nitrogen during preparation and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare Oyster Body Fluid Samples
steps.instruction: Process hemolymph (H) and pallial fluid (PF) samples separately due to limited tube capacity (1.2 ml).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 750 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant on ice.
Either refreeze pellets directly in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C, or immediately add lysis buffer RLT containing βME and proceed to extraction.

steps.title: Lysis and Tissue Disruption
steps.instruction: Lyse the frozen tissue samples using buffer RLT and mechanical disruption.

substeps.instruction: Clean working spaces and pipettes with RNase away and work under a fume hood.
Remove tubes from -80°C and keep on ice; discard strip caps.
Add 350 µl buffer RLT + βME to each tube using a multichannel pipette, ensuring tissues are well immersed.
Close tubes with new strip caps.
Disrupt samples in TissueLyser (3 times 1 min at 30 Hz at room temperature (RT)), changing plate orientation between runs to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Lysate Processing and Dilution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysates and dilute tissue samples to prevent column clogging.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge DG and G tissue lysates for 5 min at 2250 g at 22°C.
Transfer 100 µl of the supernatant to new collection microtubes containing 250 µl of buffer RLT + βME.
Mix by pipetting up and down several times.
Store any unused lysate from DG and G samples at -80°C.

steps.title: DNA Binding and RNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate DNA and RNA using the AllPrep 96 DNA plate system.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysates to an AllPrep 96 DNA plate on a new S-block, seal with airpore tape, and centrifuge for 10 min at 2250 g.
Store the AllPrep 96 DNA plate on a new S-block at 4°C for later DNA extraction.
Add 350 µl of 70% EtOH to each well of the S-block containing the flow-through and mix by pipetting up and down 3 times.
Transfer the mixture to an RNeasy 96 plate on a new S-block, seal with airpore tape, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.

steps.title: RNA Purification and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash and elute the RNA from the RNeasy 96 plate.

substeps.instruction: Discard flow-through, remove tape, add 800 µl buffer RW1, seal, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.
Discard flow-through, remove tape, add 800 µl buffer RPE, seal, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.
Discard flow-through, remove tape, add 800 µl buffer RPE again, seal, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 15 min.
Place plate on elution microtube rack, remove tape, and add 45 µl RNase-free water.
Seal with airpore tape, incubate 1-2 min at RT, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.
Repeat the elution: add another 45 µl RNase-free water, seal, incubate 1-2 min at RT, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.
Take an aliquot for concentration/quality/DNase treatment/cDNA synthesis, close rack with strip caps, and store at -80°C.

steps.title: DNA Purification and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash and elute the DNA from the AllPrep 96 DNA plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µl buffer AW1 to the AllPrep 96 DNA plate, seal with airpore tape, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.
Discard flow-through, remove tape, add 800 µl buffer AW2, seal, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 15 min.
Place plate on elution microtube rack, remove tape, and add 50 µl prewarmed buffer.
Seal with airpore tape, incubate 1-2 min at RT, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.
Repeat the elution: add another 50 µl prewarmed buffer, seal, incubate 1-2 min at RT, and centrifuge at 2250 g for 5 min.
Take an aliquot for concentration/quality measurements, close rack with strip caps, and store at -80°C.
